elaine: Quick update — Friday's company sync agenda and remote access notes. Please read and drop any Qs here by Thursday EOD.

elaine: Agenda draft: 
• 10m — Exec updates (james)
• 15m — Product roadmap highlights (marco)
• 10m — Infra & reliability recap (sophia)
• 10m — Customer / support highlights (lena)
• 15m — Q&A + open mic

elaine: Remote access: Zoom link is in the calendar invite (see pinned message). We'll enable captions and recording. If you need live ASL or extended captioning, reply here and we can add it.

elaine: Recording + condensed notes will be posted to #announcements after the meeting. If you want a deeper follow-up doc or a 1:1 with a speaker, indicate below and we'll coordinate.

james: thanks — short FYI on exec topics: hiring cadence update + one sentence on sales motion changes, will keep it tight.

marco: will show two customer stories and a short demo of the new rollout flow. If anyone has a 30s snippet they want included, DM me.

sophia: quick infra heads-up: we'll mention the weekend maintenance window and the new circuit breaker fallback. No action required for most teams, but ops/runbooks will be linked.

lena: support highlight: sharing a brief trend slide on top customer issues. Also asking folks to flag any escalations that should be discussed live.

elaine: Accessibility requests so far: @sophia — please confirm captions are enabled; @transcript-bot will post live transcript link in thread when started.

transcript-bot: Live captions enabled. Transcript URL: https://transcripts.example.com/1723456789 (will be live during the meeting).

calendar-bot: Calendar invite updated: Zoom + dial-in, captions turned on, recording permission set to company.ics attached.

james: Quick ask — can we limit deep-dive questions to the last 15m so we stay on schedule? :clock1:

elaine: Yep — we'll reserve the final 15m for open Q&A. If your question needs >3min, please add it below and we'll queue it. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
